name: Rush Hour Traffic V1 0 Ats
author: ETS2World
description:
Rush Hour Traffic v1.0 ATS

This mod has been created to give that real world traffic stress.You will find heavier traffic all over the map with a morning rush from 6 to 9 am and an evening rush from 4 to 7 pm.Traffic on the open road and side roads are heavier at times. You want see empty big cities anymore.Just remember if you load into the game and you are starting out in a major city you have to give the map time to load up traffic.It doesnt just simply appear.It takes a moment for traffic to spawn and fill in.But once it does i think those that are looking for that real life experience on the road will enjoy this.It should be compatible with any map mod because this isnt set to use with certain maps.It should be free to use with what ever map collection you choose.

name: Actual Day Night Times V1 59 Ets2
author: ETS2World
description:
Actual Day-/Night times v1.59 ETS2

This mod changes the day/night cycle to real world times. This affects the time the sun will rise or set.It works by changing the defined day from midsummer to the Wednesday of the current week. So in winter you will have long nights and short days, and in summer the reverse.Should be compatible* with every other mod, just make sure to place this one above (higher priority than) any graphics, map, or weather mods.

As long as the mod places roads and cities where they are supposed to be on the map sun times will be automatically correctly applied for where you’re driving.

The ETS2 AI Traffic No Default SCS Buses mod is designed to improve that experience.This mod removes all default SCS buses from the AI traffic pool. author: ETS2Mods
description:
AI Traffic No Default SCS Cars V1.0 ETS2

The ETS2 AI Traffic No Default SCS Cars mod is designed to improve this aspect of the game by removing all default SCS cars from AI traffic generation.Once these vehicles are removed from the traffic pool, the game will rely on other installed traffic packs and vehicle mods to populate the roads. This allows players to experience far greater traffic variety, especially when using realistic traffic packs or real-world vehicle mods.For players who enjoy building a fully customized and immersive ETS2 experience, this mod helps ensure that modded vehicles appear more frequently instead of the default cars included in the base game.

4×2 and 6×2: These refer to chassis configurations:4×2: A bus with two axles, where only the rear axle is driven. This is the standard configuration for many buses.6×2: A bus with three axles, where one of the rear axles is a liftable or fixed support axle (often called a “trucado” or “trucado” in Brazil). This configuration allows for greater passenger and luggage capacity and better weight distribution.

author: ETS2 Mods
description:
True Mirror FOV 1.58 ATS

To avoid crashes and to ensure this mod works, please give it top priority (place it on the top of mod list, over any other mods)!!!

This mod is tunning the mirrors weight, height and field of view (FOV) values to mimic the American-style truck mirrors.1. Main truck mirrors are flat (plane) on both the driver and passenger sides to provide an accurate, non-distorted, 1:1 view of distance and traffic related to the driver’s positioning.2. The smaller, curved convex mirrors help minimize blind spots by showing a distorted wide angle image of everything around the truck.3. The front and side mirrors FOVs are also modified to provide a better viewing experience for the driver.

A quick word about the 180. It is a modernization of the 691 N1 and was built while awaiting changes to the Highway Code. It stands out for its robustness and versatility. Although it didn’t remain in production for long, it was quite successful, and some are still actively used today. It retains many of its predecessor’s features, but improvements have been made and it was equipped with a more powerful engine. As an interesting aside, several of them can be seen in the Torresi yard in a late 1970s film called Un polizia scomodo. name: Urban Traffic Overhaul V22 1 Ats
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Urban Traffic Overhaul v22.1 ATS

While this mod is closer to a traffic mod than a map mod, busy areas with increased traffic spawns have to be defined manually in the map editor, requiring map edits, simply modifying definition files to increase traffic spawn rates and limits like a lot of “realistic traffic” mods do would make the whole map busy with traffic, from major cities to unpopulated rural areas, that’s why editing the map itself is necessary for decently realistic traffic density.

This mod also widens freeways and urbanizes some areas of Phoenix, just a small touch-up I’ve done years ago as that area has always bothered me in terms of accuracy. Use the available “Lite” version if you want only the scenery changes in the Phoenix Area and no edits to traffic density in cities....

author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Project “RusMap” – Global modification for the game Euro Truck Simulator 2. This modification has been developed since 2014 and covers the European part of Russia and the Republic of Belarus. The following regions are represented in Russia: In the north – Moscow, Leningrad, Tver, Novgorod, Pskov, Murmansk and the Republic of Karelia. In the west – Kaluga, Bryansk, Smolensk, Tula, Oryol, Kursk, Belgorod. In the south – Voronezh, Tambov, Penza, Lipetsk, Saratov and Volgograd regions. In the Republic of Belarus, six regions are represented: Minsk, Vitebsk, Mogilev, Gomel, Grodno and Brest regions.

The map is compatible with other popular projects such as ProMods, Roextended Map, SibirMap, Southern Region Map, Volga Map and many other modifications.

In the Republic of Belarus, six regions are represented: Minsk, Vitebsk, Mogilev, Gomel, Grodno and Brest regions.

Designed for off-road hauling, it includes reinforced suspension, Mega/Volvo/Mercedes engine options (e.g., 300–400 hp), and authentic Brazilian liveries. The 1.54 update ensures stability, while mods may add animated tipping, dirt effects, or company logos. Ideal for mining or roadwork roleplay, it delivers rugged practicality.

The Volvo Classic (1.54) in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a nostalgic truck mod showcasing Volvo’s iconic 1970s-1990s models like the F88/F89 or N10/N12. Featuring retro cab designs, manual transmissions, and legendary turbo-diesel engines (e.g., TD100 series, 300–400 hp), it delivers old-school trucking charm. The 1.54 update ensures compatibility, while mods may add period-correct liveries, vintage accessories, and classic trailer combos. Ideal for historic hauls or retro fleet roleplay, it celebrates Volvo’s golden era.

Featuring Librelato-branded construction, dual interconnected trailers, and realistic hydraulic tipping mechanics, it pairs with 6×4 or 8×4 trucks like Volvo FH or Scania R-series. Scania R500 1.54 ETS2

The Scania R500 1.54 in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a premium long-haul truck from Scania’s R-series, featuring a powerful 13-liter 500hp V8 engine, streamlined design for fuel efficiency, and a spacious, ergonomic cabin with advanced driver amenities. The 1.54 update ensures optimal performance, while the truck includes customization options for chassis, interiors, and exterior styling. Ideal for heavy cargo transport and long-distance journeys, it combines reliability with Scania’s signature performance.

name: Basculante New R Free 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Basculante New R FREE 1.54 ETS2

The Basculante New R FREE 1.54 in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a specialized dump truck mod designed for construction and off-road hauling, featuring a functional tilting cargo bed for unloading materials like sand or gravel. Built on a robust chassis (often Scania or Volvo-based), it includes realistic physics for load handling, customizable liveries, and heavy-duty suspension for rough terrain. The 1.54 update ensures stability, while mods may add animated hydraulics or work-site accessories. Ideal for mining or roadwork simulations, it delivers hands-on cargo management.

name: Pack 9 Eixos 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
PACK 9 EIXOS 1.54 ETS2

The PACK 9 EIXOS 1.54 in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a heavy-duty multi-axle truck mod designed for oversized and extreme cargo transport, featuring a 9-axle configuration for maximum weight distribution and stability. It includes a modular chassis system, customizable trailer attachments, and high-torque engines to handle massive loads like industrial equipment or wind turbine components. The 1.54 update ensures compatibility, while mods may add adjustable suspension, beacon lights, and specialized cargo skins. Ideal for super-heavy haulage challenges or niche transport roleplay, it prioritizes raw power and precision.

name: Iveco Stralis Iii 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
IVECO Stralis III 1.54 ETS2

The Iveco Stralis III (1.54) in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a modern long-haul truck from Iveco’s flagship series, featuring a sleek aerodynamic design, fuel-efficient Cursor 11/13 engines (up to 570 hp), and a driver-centric cabin with ergonomic controls. The 1.54 update ensures compatibility, while the truck offers customizable options like chassis configurations, interior trims, and fleet liveries. Ideal for efficient freight transport, it balances performance and low emissions for cross-continental routes.

name: Mercedes Benz Mp1 1997 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Mercedes-Benz MP1 1997 1.54 ETS2

The Mercedes-Benz MP1 1997 (1.54) in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a classic 90s-era truck mod replicating the iconic Mercedes-Benz SK/MK series, known for its durability and boxy design. It features a no-frills interior, reliable V6 or inline-6 engines (e.g., OM441LA, 350–500 hp), and period-correct chassis options (4×2, 6×4). The 1.54 update ensures stability, while mods may include retro liveries, manual transmission support, and vintage accessory packs. Ideal for nostalgic hauls or historic fleet roleplay, it delivers an authentic late-20th-century trucking experience.

name: Bau E Camara Fria 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
BAU E CAMARA FRIA 1.54 ETS2

The BAU E CAMARA FRIA 1.54 in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a specialized refrigerated box truck mod, designed for temperature-sensitive cargo transport. Featuring a BAU-branded rigid chassis with an integrated cold storage unit (“Câmara Fria”), it includes realistic refrigeration mechanics, customizable cargo types (e.g., perishable goods), and detailed Brazilian livery options. The 1.54 update ensures compatibility, while mods may add functional temperature controls or frost effects on the cargo box. Ideal for food delivery roleplay or regional logistics, it combines utility with authenticity for short-to-medium hauls.

name: Tanque Facchini 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
TANQUE FACCHINI 1.54 ETS2

The TANQUE FACCHINI 1.54 in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a specialized tanker truck mod designed for liquid cargo transport, featuring a realistic tank trailer with detailed Faccini-branded design (a Brazilian manufacturer). The mod includes customizable tank types (fuel, chemicals, or food-grade liquids), physics-based liquid sloshing effects, and industry-standard safety markings. The 1.54 update ensures stability, while mods may add animated hoses, loading/unloading functions, or regional company liveries. Ideal for hazardous material hauls or fuel delivery simulations, it emphasizes realism in bulk liquid transport.

name: Pack Florestal 1 54 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
PACK FLORESTAL 1.54 ETS2

The PACK FLORESTAL 1.54 in Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a specialized forestry truck mod designed for timber transport, featuring a reinforced chassis, heavy-duty logging trailer compatibility, and off-road capabilities for rugged terrain. It includes realistic log-loading mechanics, customizable cabin accessories (e.g., protective grilles, mud flaps), and authentic Brazilian or European forestry liveries. The 1.54 update ensures smooth operation, while mods may add animated cranes or environmental wear effects. Ideal for logging roleplay or challenging haulage missions, it emphasizes durability and functionality.

name: Police Tweaks V1 0 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Police Tweaks v1.0 ETS2

Tweaks police fines and probabilityMost fine chances for when there is no cop around removed or lowered. No more double fines if a cop spots you.

With no cop around, there is no chance of a fine for:– Driving without lights– Passing a red light– Speeding (without a speed camera)

And lowered chances for:– Driving the wrong way (40% down from 60% – if no cop is around, someone may still call emergency)– Speeding past a speed camera (90% instead of 100%)

In addition to this the time before the first speeding fine is increased, giving you a chance to slow down, and the time between sleep avoiding fines is increased.

name: Actual Day Night Times V1 53 1 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Actual Day-/Night times v1.53.1 ETS2

This mod changes the day/night cycle to real world times. This affects the time the sun will rise or set.

It works by changing the defined day from midsummer to the Wednesday of the current week. So in winter you will have long nights and short days, and in summer the reverse.

Should be compatible* with every other mod, just make sure to place this one above (higher priority than) any graphics, map, or weather mods.As long as the mod places roads and cities where they are supposed to be on the map sun times will be automatically correctly applied for where you’re driving.

description:

While this mod is closer to a traffic mod than a map mod, busy areas with increased traffic spawns have to be defined manually in the map editor, requiring map edits, simply modifying definition files to increase traffic spawn rates and limits like a lot of “realistic traffic” mods do would make the whole map busy with traffic, from major cities to unpopulated rural areas, that’s why editing the map itself is necessary for decently realistic traffic density.

author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Mygotopia – Grand Utopia Addon v0.6 1.52 ETS2

ChangesUpdated for 1.52Adapted for Grand Utopia 1.16.2Converted to HashfsV2

Mygotopia Map is an official addon for Grand Utopia– It unlocks a brand-new country located in the north of the island of Grand Utopia.– This new country is not inspired by France. This time, I let my imagination run wild to offer you a different kind of immersion, in a fictional nation that could be situated halfway between American and European culture.– Mygotopia is a vast country, synonymous with wide open spaces. The fact that this map is created on a continent instead of an island means that there is more space between towns and villages to create more beautiful and realistic landscapes. Good to know, the official language in Mygotopia is English (not French!).

Located south of Grand Utopia, Akokan is a French tropical island attached to the Grand Utopia region. As this territory is not very urbanised, the vast majority of the Akokanese population lives in Port-Méli, the main village. However, you will find several small remote hamlets, lost in the middle of an abundant and inhospitable nature. The island has been classified as a Utopian nature reserve. So, don’t forget your spare wheels because there, except in Port-Méli, few roads are paved. author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Actual Day & Night Times v1.52 ATS

This mod changes the day/night cycle to real world times. This affects the time the sun will rise or set.

It works by changing the defined day from midsummer to the Wednesday of the current week. So in winter you will have long nights and short days, and in summer the reverse.

Should be compatible* with every other mod, just make sure to place this one above (higher priority than) any graphics, map, or weather mods.As long as the mod places roads and cities where they are supposed to be on the map sun times will be automatically correctly applied for where you’re driving.

author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Peyrat-le-Château (map addon) v1.0 1.51 ETS2

Peyrat-le-Château is a small town which is located near Limoges, in France. In the base game, it is purely decorative as it is not shown on the map and has no companies. This mod then adds small accessible and fully functional companies from which you can take jobs. You can also discover a customized, purchasable garage. It remains a simple addition to the game that may potentially appeal to some.

Map compatibilityThe mod works very well with other maps such as Promods or Sud de France. Pay attention to the loading order which remains important despite everything since you must position this mod above Promods.

description:

This mod changes the day/night cycle to real world times. This affects the time the sun will rise or set.It works by changing the defined day from midsummer to the Wednesday of the current week. So in winter you will have long nights and short days, and in summer the reverse.

Should be compatible* with every other mod, just make sure to place this one above (higher priority than) any graphics, map, or weather mods.As long as the mod places roads and cities where they are supposed to be on the map sun times will be automatically correctly applied for where you’re driving.

description:
MAAPA OESTE BAIANO V4.8 1.50 ETS2

The game is giving an error/closing/bug after installing the mod. What should I do?There are several factors that could be causing this to happen. The first is whether the version of the game is the same as the mod (we always put this in the description). Secondly, the mod doesn’t conflict with another mod, which usually happens when you install two or more mods from the same category, such as 2 or 3 different maps, sound packs, and so on. The correct thing to do is to add mod by mod and then see which one is causing the problem.

name: Cadillac V16 1930 1 50 Ets2
author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Cadillac V16 1930 1.50 ETS2

Cadillac V16 1930 – this modification adds a old classic vintage car model for ATS / ETS2 players with own interior, wheels and passengers. 1930 was one of the most important years in Cadillac history. The brand was the first in the world to present a production car with a V-16 engine. The Cadillac V16 was a luxury car produced by Cadillac from 1930 to 1940. It was one of the most expensive and prestigious cars of the time, costing around $7,500 (equivalent to over $100,000 today). Despite its high price tag and the onset of the Great Depression, the Cadillac V16 was a success, with around 4,000 units produced over the course of its 10-year production run. The car remains a highly sought-after collector’s item today.

author: ETS2 Mods
description:
Peterbilt 351 v1.0 1.50 ATS

Peterbilt’s lightweight model 351 was a worthy successor to the model 350, offering shorter wheelbases and more optimized weight distribution. The difference in sales numbers is very telling, with over 7000 351’s being sold 1954-1976 vs 847 350’s 1949-1957. It’s fairly safe to say that the 351 was the model that really drove Peterbilt conventionals to the success they continue to enjoy.

This mod seeks to recapture some of the magic of this pivotal truck model, including one of its iconic movie appearances!
